Test case automation tool

Built a tool that automated test case creation from Japanese test scenarios for a major Japanese video game company, nearly doubling the team’s test creation speed.

  • ~2× faster test case creation
  • Automation
  • Engineering
  • Japanese clients

The problem

On a project for a major Japanese video game company, our team received test scenarios written in Japanese and had to turn each one into test cases by hand. It was slow, repetitive work, and the volume kept growing.

What I did

  • Built an automation tool that generated test cases from the scenarios, replacing most of the manual writing.

The outcome

  • Test case creation speed increased by almost 100%, nearly doubling the team’s output.
